response.description: PostgreSQL Hub for Azure Developers brings together key AI and application development resources for PostgreSQL on Azure. It includes curated sample apps and solution accelerators, tutorials, and structured learning pathways to help you build everything from core applications to AI agents. Featured resources stay current with the latest updates.The hub also provides a space to connect with other developers. You can start discussions, share knowledge, and collaborate more closely with Microsoft and ecosystem experts as the community continues to grow.Learn more.
